This skill is based on discipline of the body rather than knowledge. With high Combat Mastery skill, you deliver more powerful attacks than someone who is not using this skill. While this skill does not have fancy, conspicuous effects like other skills, it has an automatic, general effect in close-quarter combat. | ## Details - Passively increases Minimum and Maximum [Damage](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Damage "Damage") and [Balance](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Balance "Balance") of melee attacks, as well as [Health](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Stats#Life "Stats"), [Strength](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Strength "Strength"), and [Dexterity](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Dexterity "Dexterity"). - Increases HP by 10 and Balance by 1% per Rank. Other stats are dependent on [Race](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Category:Player_Races "Category:Player Races"). - Max/Min Damage from Combat Mastery affects all melee weapons (ranged weapons such as [Bows](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Bows_List "Bows List"), [Crossbows](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Crossbows_List "Crossbows List"), [Atlatls](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Atlatls_List "Atlatls List"), [Shuriken](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Shuriken_List "Shuriken List"), and [Dual Guns](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Dual_Guns_List "Dual Guns List") are not affected). - Balance from Combat Mastery affects all weapons, including ranged ones. - If a [Human](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Human "Human") or [Giant](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Giant "Giant") player is [Dual Wielding](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Dual_Wielding "Dual Wielding"), the bonuses from Combat Mastery will apply **once** despite having two weapons. - Rank C Combat Mastery is required to obtain the quest for [Blaze](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Blaze "Blaze") and [Evasion](https://wiki.mabinogiworld.com/view/Evasion "Evasion"); Rank 5 is required to obtain the quest for [Rage Description

 Combat Mastery skill is an essential skill for more effective engagement in close-quarter combat. This skill is based on discipline of the body rather than knowledge. With high Combat Mastery skill, you deliver more powerful attacks than someone who is not using this skill. While this skill does not have fancy, conspicuous effects like other skills, it has an automatic, general effect in close-quarter combat.

Details

  • Passively increases Minimum and Maximum Damage and Balance of melee attacks, as well as Health, Strength, and Dexterity.
    • Increases HP by 10 and Balance by 1% per Rank. Other stats are dependent on Race.
  • Max/Min Damage from Combat Mastery affects all melee weapons (ranged weapons such as Bows, Crossbows, Atlatls, Shuriken, and Dual Guns are not affected).
    • Balance from Combat Mastery affects all weapons, including ranged ones.
  • If a Human or Giant player is Dual Wielding, the bonuses from Combat Mastery will apply once despite having two weapons.
  • Rank C Combat Mastery is required to obtain the quest for Blaze and Evasion; Rank 5 is required to obtain the quest for Rage Impact and Bash.
